english.title: Deliver pursuant to a delivery arrangement a bladed article to a person under 18
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a body corporate, who had entered into an arrangement with a seller, namely **(..SPECIFY SELLER..), in accordance with section 42(1) of the Offensive Weapons Act 2019, delivered a bladed article, namely **(..SPECIFY BLADED ARTICLE..), otherwise than into the hands of a person age 18 years or over
english.legislation: Contrary to section 42(1), (4) and (10)(a) of the Offensive Weapons Act 2019.

english.notes:
(i) 'bladed article' is defined in section 42(11) as any article to which section 141A of the Criminal Justice Act applies.
(ii) 'bladed product' does not apply to flick knives, gravity knives, an order made by the Secretary of State or an order under section 141(A)(3)(c) of the Criminal Justice Act 1988.(iii) A defence is available at section 42(5) when a person takes all reasonable precautions and exercises due diligence.
(iv) Please note the transitional requirement in regulation 3 of SI 2022/418 – stating this offence does not apply where the sale referred to in section 42(1)(a) of the Act takes place before 6th April 2022 and the person referred to in section 42(1)(e) of the Act has not delivered the bladed article by that date.
